text:
anjali: Heads-up — NebulaChip (HW partner) asked to kick off a small preview/alpha for their new A1 accelerator. They want NDA + a lightweight benchmark pass and feedback loop by mid-Apr

anjali: Goal is to validate latency/cost profiles for our Dedicated runtime and capture perf deltas for quantized models. Also check marketplace packaging impact (AMI/container).

derek: +1. Do we have an NDA draft in flight or should I ping legal?

anjali: @legal-bot — can you confirm if the template NDA we used with other silicon partners is OK or if we need custom clauses for telemetry/benchmark artifact sharing?

legal-bot: FYI the standard HW partner NDA is OK but we need to add one clause re: telemetry retention period (default 90 days). I can spin a version and tag @anjali.

sam: For bench plan — recommend we run 3 profiles: short-chat (seq=256), long completion (seq=2048), and streaming latency (interactive). Capture p99 latency and tokens/sec.

elena: Also collect KV-cache memory usage and peak GPU mem per sequence. NebulaChip asked specifically about kernel warmup behavior.

derek: I sketched a minimal benchmark script the infra team can run. Using our bench harness:
```
./run_bench --target nebula-a1 --model redwood-7b-q4 --seq 2048 --warmup 50 --iter 200 --metrics p50,p90,p99,tokens_per_sec
```
Put logs in s3://redwood-eval/nebula/alpha/<run-id>

anjali: Perfect. @tchao (NebulaChip) can you confirm access details for the A1 instances (AMI or container) and whether you want us to run on your lab or on Dedicated nodes in our cloud?

tchao (NebulaChip): We can provide an AMI and temporary SSH creds to a lab account. Prefer we run in our lab first, then replicate in Dedicated. We'll also share a telemetry consumer for the kernel-level traces (we only need aggregated numbers).

sam: For reproducibility, let's pin the runtime commit and CUDA/cuDNN-like libs in the run script and record env: `git rev-parse HEAD`, `nvidia-smi` output, and `ldd` of the runtime binary.

elena: Who's owning the feedback loop? I can aggregate results and surface diffs vs baseline. Need a small rubric for perf/regressions.

anjali: @elena you lead results, @derek owns bench execution, @sam owns run scripting and env capture. I'll coordinate NDA + partner comms.

tchao (NebulaChip): Timeline check — NDA by EOD Thursday, bench run next week, and a 1-hour sync with our engineering on Wed. Is that workable?

derek: Thursday NDA is fine if legal fast-tracks. Bench next week is good — I'll queue infra access.

legal-bot: NDA draft created and attached to the partner workspace. @anjali please review — I added telemetry retention clause and removed language flagged by compliance.

anjali: Thanks. Quick note on marketplace packaging: if we see >10% perf delta between AMI and container, we'll file a follow-up action to optimize launcher/packaging. Worth flagging to Nebula now.

tchao (NebulaChip): Good call. We'll log packaging differences. Also happy to share early kernel patches if you find regressions.

sam: I'll post the bench script + env checklist in the partnership repo after this thread. Anyone want to be CCed on run artifacts?

elena: Add me and @anjali. Also add the runtime team channel for debugging: #eng-runtime.

anjali: Great — next steps: 1) legal sends NDA (in progress) 2) infra gets creds and AMI 3) derek runs bench 4) elena aggregates + sync Wed. Thanks everyone :rocket:

end of thread
